notes.title: Update 59: Auto/Manual Save Separation & Story Skip Optimization!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, handsome Rebels! Good afternoon! 《Rebellion GodSoul》 has just received some new convenience features—especially for save files and story skip optimizations![/p]
[p]📅 [b]EA V1.59 – Around 16:00, September 8, 2025[/b][/p]
[p][b]Update Details:[/b][/p]
[olist]
[][p][b]Save Slot & Sorting Optimization[/b][/p]
[list]
[][p]Manual saves and auto saves are now displayed separately.[/p][/]
[][p]All previous auto saves will now be treated as manual saves.[/p][/]
[][p]Auto save list now sorts by date automatically, with the latest save shown at the top for easier access.[/p][/]
[][p]If you wish to clean up saves, please go to:
C:\Users\【Your Username】\AppData\Local\GodSoul\Saved\SaveGames and delete manually.[/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/89737c2a79d55fe838ca7e05eac1d3b56c189c96.png"][/img][/p][/]
[/list][/]

[][p][b]Transition Effect Optimization[/b][/p]
[list]
[][p]Adjusted some transition effects for better presentation.[/p][/]
[/list][/]

[][p][b]Abyss Connection Adjustment[/b] – now with clearer directionality[/p][/]

[][p][b]Story Skip Expansion[/b][/p]
[list]
[][p]Spirit-joining story events can now be skipped. Skipping still grants the Spirit as normal (previously, due to bugs, joining and some affinity events could not be skipped).[/p][/]
[][p]Now, except for the protagonist’s naming scene, all story events can be skipped with one click.[/p][/]
[][p]Tip: Story skip function is located in the [b]gear icon at the top right[/b] menu.[/p][/]
[/list][/]

[][p][b]Localization Update[/b][/p]
[list]
[][p]Added Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese draft translations for Kami Aposta’s affinity story (Part 6 onward).[/p][/]
[][p]During EA, localization is done internally and may not be perfect. We welcome feedback from players fluent in English/Japanese via [b]Discord[/b].[/p][/]
[/list][/]
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/eb22d5593c83dfd76429296b1b5c0e4b001b6588.gif"][/img][/p]

We’ll share real gameplay footage as soon as it’s ready to show.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you for playing "Rebellious Godsoul"![/p][p]If you think the game is worth it, please recommend it to your friends—your support greatly helps our development![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790087/1b6a6fece2ff21dc08511398ca61d91f4775db7d.gif"][/img][/p]
